install: set -euxo pipefail; need_node=0; if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then need_node=1; elif [ "$(node -p 'Number(process.versions.node.split(`.`)[0])')" -lt 20 ]; then need_node=1; fi; if ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then need_node=1; fi; if [ "$need_node" -eq 1 ]; then if ! command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Node.js >=20 and npm are required but apt-get is unavailable' >&2; exit 1; fi; sudo apt-get update; sudo apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg; curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | sudo -E bash -; sudo apt-get install -y nodejs; fi; if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update; sudo apt-get install -y ffmpeg; fi; if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; else npm install --no-audit --no-fund; fi
